UserSummary.description: A GitHub user summary (common across many responses).

avatar_url.description: URL to the user's avatar image.

html_url.description: HTML URL to the user's profile.

url.description: API URL for the user resource.

truncated.description: Whether the response was truncated (> 100k entries or 7MB).

GitTreeEntry.description: A single entry in a Git tree.

mode.description: Git file mode (e.g., "100644" for regular file).

PullRequestSummary.title: PullRequestSummary
PullRequestSummary.description: Pull request summary from list endpoints.

draft.description: Whether this is a draft PR.

labels.description:
Labels applied to the PR.

GitHub returns labels on PRs through the same `labels` array shape
used by issues. The list endpoint includes this field by default,
but `#[serde(default)]` keeps older fixtures (or alternative APIs
that omit it) deserializable.

PullRequestFile.title: PullRequestFile
PullRequestFile.description: A file changed in a pull request.

contents_url.description: URL to view the file at this commit.

pull_request.description:
Pull request info (present if this issue is a PR).

Use `.is_some()` to distinguish issues from PRs.

TimelineEvent.title: TimelineEvent
TimelineEvent.description: A timeline event on an issue.

id.description: Event ID (may be absent for some event types).

TagCommit.description: Commit info embedded in a tag.

tag_name.description: Tag name associated with the release.

ReleaseAsset.description: An asset attached to a release.

GitRefObject.description: Object pointed to by a Git reference.

TagObjectRef.description: Object reference from an annotated tag.

WorkflowRunsResponse.title: WorkflowRunsResponse
WorkflowRunsResponse.description:
Response from `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs`.

Contains a total count and a list of workflow runs.

total_count.description: Total number of workflow runs matching the query.

WorkflowRun.description: A single workflow run from GitHub Actions.

actor.description: The actor who triggered the run.

event.description: The event that triggered the workflow (e.g., "push", "pull_request").

head_branch.description: The branch or tag ref that triggered the run.

head_sha.description: The commit SHA at the head of the run.

html_url.description: HTML URL to the workflow run.

triggering_actor.description: The actor who triggered the re-run (if applicable).

workflow_id.description: The workflow ID this run belongs to.
